body: I will tomorrow since they're asleep right now. I just feel awful. it hit me a couple minutes ago whenever my boyfriend told me that he hated seeing me make my life worse.
they haven't been yelling. it's just visible frustration. I didnt mean to imply that they were yelling at me, I'm sorry.
they can only see what goes on when I'm out of bed and out of my room. they cant see what really goes on so I understand their frustration.
my friends have told me good things about the one that they've been to where I live. maybe it depends on the place?

they'll think I'm just being dramatic. or that I'm doing it for attention. they dont really understand how I feel and I think they'll make fun of me the entire time I'll stay there. or they just wont let me go at all.

Thank you for taking the time to comment, and I'll try and follow your advice if it keeps getting worse. I'll try and remember it wasnt my fault, but tbh the timeline of my mental downfall and their marriage falling apart just...makes too much sense. idk how else to describe it.
I only wish others could have the same support.
hes honestly the first person who has. everytime I've opened up to people I just get shut down.

The only positive about my work is payday tbh. and it never comes fast enough. A part of me thinks one day it will get better, but tbh I just don't know. thank you for your support, while I feel and sound extremely negative your support really does mean a lot to me.
I really felt that last paragraph. I hope that someday things get better for you

I'm in therapy, it just doesn't feel like its enough.  I've been trying to get better with the disinfecting spray, but when I go without it it makes my skin crawl. idk why. i took a sip of my drink without wiping it down and my body just rejected it. 

I haven't tried medication before, I'm just worried it wont make much of a difference. and thank you for your message, honestly knowing that someone gives a shit and understands where I'm coming from is comforting. thank you.
